How we know

Laramie BikeNet's group rides page lists the Tuesday night hammer ride at 6 pm from the end of Willett Dr; the page's last edit stamp is Nov 16, 2025 and nothing on it is dated 2026 (fetched Oct 1, 2026).

Hosted by
Laramie BikeNetNonprofit
Kind of ride
Mountain bike

For visitors

Laramie BikeNet says it is a drop ride and the format changes: some weeks a full effort up the hill, some weeks hard segments with regroups. It also lines up with the Laramie City Tuesday night races.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Self-paced and hard; a drop ride. It's a drop ride: if you can't hold the pace, you'll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @laramiebikenet the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Hammer Ride (MTB) group ride

Tuesday Night Hammer Ride (MTB) is a mountain bike group ride in Laramie, WY. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from End of Willett Dr.

A mountain bike ride where you go as hard as you want. Some weeks it is a long effort up a route, some weeks it is a hard segment then a regroup. It is a drop ride, so know the trails or bring a map.
